title: She invested for 10 years and STOPPED — still beat him
disclaimer: Hypothetical: $100/month at a 7% average annual return, compounded monthly. Not financial advice — real returns vary.

scenes.narration: She invested for just ten years, then stopped completely. He invested for thirty years straight. Guess who has more money at sixty-five?
Both put in one hundred dollars a month at a seven percent return. Anna invests from twenty-five to thirty-five, then stops forever. Ben starts at thirty-five and never stops.
Here's the thing. Anna only put in twelve thousand dollars total. Ben put in thirty-six thousand. Three times more. So Ben wins, right? Guess again.
At sixty-five, Anna has about one hundred and forty thousand dollars. Ben has about one hundred and twenty-two thousand. Anna wins, with way less money in.
Anna invested three times less than Ben, and still ended up with more. That's the power of starting early.
